DIRECT_REFERENCE_MATCH.label: DIRECT REFERENCE MATCH
DIRECT_REFERENCE_MATCH.meaning: Medicine and indication match a structured clinic prescription pathway; current usable stock and patient-safety checks passed.

EXPLICIT_REFERENCE_SUBSTITUTE.label: SUPPORTED INVENTORY MATCH
EXPLICIT_REFERENCE_SUBSTITUTE.meaning: The structured pathway explicitly allows this inventory substitute; it is not an invented substitution.

SUPPORTED_INVENTORY_FALLBACK.label: SUPPORTED INVENTORY FALLBACK
SUPPORTED_INVENTORY_FALLBACK.meaning: No exact structured medicine was matched, but the selected protocol permits an inventory fallback and safety checks passed.

MANUAL.label: MANUAL SELECTION
MANUAL.meaning: Added manually by the clinician; the tool does not claim that the selection is protocol-matched.

NO_SAFE_AUTOMATIC_MATCH.label: NO SAFE AUTOMATIC MATCH
NO_SAFE_AUTOMATIC_MATCH.meaning: No medicine should be auto-selected from current usable stock.

selectionOrder: FEFO within the same suitable clinical stock group

databaseAudit.purpose: Flags incomplete medicine metadata without inventing missing values.

exclude: inventory purchase price as prescription cost unless explicitly recorded
